# JinFit

> > Women's health and fitness studio in Penarth, Wales, specializing in pre/postnatal care, group classes, and transformation programs.

Founded by Janine Osborne-Bowring, JinFit offers diverse fitness classes including Jin Fonda, JumpFit, CircHIIT, Barre, and kettlebell training both in-studio and online via Zoom. The studio focuses on women's fitness across all life stages with specialist programs for pregnancy, postnatal recovery, menopause, and weight management.

## Key Topics

- Women's fitness and health
- Pre/postnatal training
- Menopause fitness
- Jin Fonda (dance aerobics)
- JumpFit (trampoline workout)
- CircHIIT (HIIT circuits)
- Barre fitness
- KettleBell Flow
- Barbelles (barbell training)
- SWEAT transformation program
- Group exercise classes
- Online Zoom classes
- Penarth, Cardiff, Wales
- Weight management
- Gym membership options
